title: We built a hybrid crypto trading system: algorithmic execution + human risk oversight — 116 days of live results
author: profittoinvest
selftext:
**Profitto Invest is now officially available on the Cornix Marketplace.**

This is an important milestone for us because our results can now be independently viewed and compared directly inside Cornix.

From the beginning, we have said that our first priority is not aggressive marketing, but **building a transparent and verifiable track record**.

Now we have both.

# Cornix Marketplace results

At the moment Cornix reports:

**1 Month: +14.39%**  
**3 Months: +77.08%**  
**6 Months: +39.18%**

Marketplace Score: **72/100**

# Three results — three different methodologies

At first glance, there is a large difference between the performance of our LIVE account, the Cornix backtest we recreated ourselves, and the official Marketplace statistics.

That is why we want to show all three numbers openly:

**+233.47% — real LIVE BingX account, July 4th to October 27th**  
**+168.1% — Cornix backtest recreated by us for exactly the same 116-day period, using 10,000 USDT initial capital and a flat 500 USDT stake per trade**  
**+77.08% — official Cornix Marketplace 3-month result**

These are three different ways of measuring the same system, and **we do not expect them to produce identical results**.

In fact, the differences between them are valuable information because they show the impact of execution method, historical signal configuration, capital management, and additional risk-control mechanisms.

So instead of selecting only the most favorable number, we are showing all three and explaining why they differ.

What matters most is understanding how the Marketplace statistics were calculated.

The current Marketplace statistics are **not a perfect representation of the strategy we have been running LIVE since July 4th**.

There are several reasons for this.

First, Cornix Marketplace uses the full historical signal history of the Telegram channel.

Before July 4th, the same channel was used for testing earlier versions of the system. At the time, we did not realize those old signals would later become part of the Marketplace 6-month calculation.

Second, some historical signals were calculated using execution settings that were different from our final production configuration.

Our current strategy uses:

**Entry: 100% at the first entry**  
**TP1: 5%**  
**TP2: 5%**  
**TP3: 90%**

Historically, Cornix did not have these values enforced at the channel level, so earlier Marketplace calculations used a different allocation model. (Equal split of \~33.3% per TP)

We have now corrected the channel configuration so that future signals use the proper execution model.

Despite these differences, the independent Cornix calculation still shows **+77.08% over the last 3 months**.

Considering that this result was generated under execution conditions that were not fully optimized for our strategy, we consider this a very interesting result.

# We also recreated the Cornix backtest ourselves

To make the comparison as fair as possible, we used the standard Cornix Marketplace assumptions:

**Initial capital: 10,000 USDT**  
**Flat stake: 500 USDT per trade**  
**Exchange: BingX Futures**  
**Period: July 4th – October 27th**  
**116 days**

The result:

**Net PnL: +168.1%**  
**Max Drawdown: 24.31%**

The backtest generated more than 800 trades during this period.

That is important because it shows that the strategy does not depend on a handful of lucky trades.

It has been repeatedly exposed to different market conditions.

# What about the LIVE account?

The BingX account connected to the bot produced:

**+233.47% from July 4th to October 27th.**

So why is the LIVE result higher than the passive Cornix backtest?

Because Profitto Invest is not designed as a completely blind “turn it on and forget it forever” system.

We use several additional risk-control mechanisms depending on market structure, trend, and portfolio exposure.

Some of them require intervention.

This is why we describe Profitto Invest as a **hybrid trading system: algorithmic automation + human risk oversight**.

The bot generates and executes the strategy systematically, while a separate monitoring layer watches conditions that may require defensive action.

For example, one of our protection mechanisms can generate an instruction to close **all positions in one direction — LONG or SHORT**.

For Cornix-connected clients, this type of action can be performed centrally from the administrator side.

Before doing so, we will notify users through our Discord community and other communication channels.

Example:

**“Risk condition triggered. All SHORT positions will be closed in 6 hours.”**

Users therefore know in advance what is happening and why.

# What if you do not want to make any interventions?

This was one of the most important things we tested.

We have run **hundreds of historical backtests going back to 2020**.

Our conclusion is that the underlying strategy remained profitable even without the additional intervention layer, but the trade-off was deeper drawdowns.

In other words:

The interventions are not what creates the entire strategy.

They are primarily used to **control risk, reduce prolonged exposure, and smooth the equity curve**.

This is an important distinction.

# You do not have to use Cornix

We also wanted the strategy to remain usable for people who cannot or do not want to connect through Cornix.

For this reason, our signals are generated at predictable times.

Most signals appear approximately:

**1–2 minutes after the full hour.**

That means you do not need to watch Telegram all day.

You can simply set an hourly reminder, check whether a new signal has appeared, and execute it manually.

During the 116-day test period, we recorded approximately **836 signals**, which works out to a little over **7 signals per day on average**.

So despite the large historical sample, the daily workload is not extreme.

Manual execution is still possible.

# Coin selection

We focus mainly on popular, highly liquid cryptocurrency markets.

The objective is not to search for obscure low-liquidity coins in order to manufacture unrealistic backtest returns.

We want instruments that can realistically be traded by our users.

Availability varies slightly between exchanges, so if a specific exchange does not support every symbol in our standard universe, we have additional tested replacement pairs available.

We can help users build the best available pair set for their exchange.

# We manage the portfolio - not individual trades

This is one of the most important concepts behind Profitto Invest.

We do not judge the system by asking:

**“Did this individual trade win?”**

We look at the complete portfolio.

At any moment, there may be profitable positions, losing positions, LONG exposure, and SHORT exposure at the same time.

The strategy is designed around the interaction of the entire portfolio.

This is also why Hedge Mode is important for us.

# Position sizing

Our standard starting allocation is approximately **4% of initial capital per signal**.

It is a fixed amount based on the initial account size.

This intentionally means that sometimes there will not be enough free capital to execute every signal.

That is not necessarily a problem.

Our historical testing showed that allowing capital constraints instead of forcing every trade can still produce very strong results.

We also do not aggressively compound the position size after every profitable trade.

Instead, position size can be reviewed periodically.

A typical increase would be approximately **10–30% of the original stake**, depending on account growth, available free capital, and the previous month’s performance.

The objective is controlled scaling — not maximum possible leverage.

# Why are we showing all of this?

Because our goal is to build a serious long-term product.

That requires:

**Transparency.**  
**Repeatable methodology.**  
**Risk control.**  
**Real trading history.**  
**Independent verification.**

We will continue publishing our LIVE results, just as we have done since July.

At the same time, Cornix Marketplace now provides an additional independent data source that anyone can inspect.

The Marketplace history will also gradually become more representative of the final strategy as older test signals and legacy execution settings roll out of the historical windows.

We are not claiming that past results guarantee future performance.

They do not.

What we are showing is that the system has now been tested:

**historically,**  
**in live trading,**  
**through different drawdowns,**  
**through different market conditions,**  
**and independently through Cornix.**

And we will continue documenting what happens next.

**Profitto Invest | VIP Auto Signals is now available on Cornix Marketplace.**

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: you froze the config in July if I remember right, so at least the live number is clean. three numbers for one strategy, live, your own recreated backtest and the marketplace backtest, and they disagree. that disagreement is worth more than any of the three on its own. my guess is fees and fills, the backtests pay a price the live account never got. which of the three sits closest to live per trade?

replies.author: profittoinvest
replies.body: The backtest we conducted ourselves on Cornix the one showing +168% is the most accurate. It uses the correct bot settings. Unfortunately, the backtest on the Cornix Marketplace uses different, outdated settings. It turns out that these settings were not updated at the group level; they had only been changed within the bot itself that is, on the user's end..... We only discovered this after Cornix support pointed it out to us.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: that explains the marketplace gap, not the live gap. your own backtest and the live account ran the same settings from July, so what sits between +168% and the live line is cost: fees, the fill you got against the close the backtest assumed, and funding if any of it is perps. that residual per trade tells you more than the +168% does.

replies.author: profittoinvest
replies.body:

replies.author: profittoinvest
replies.body: At present, AI is not capable of building a system that generates stable profits - that is my opinion of course, though I could be wrong. In my case, I provide the entire strategy, and I come up with ideas to improve it based on backtest results. I propose various solutions to be tested, which I then evaluate alongside the AI. I also have an agent of my own that learns from the outcomes and backtests to suggest its own ideas. If I were to leave everything to the AI, I doubt I would be able to build a stable system. AI has a tendency to overcomplicate things adding random indicators, constructing complex signal-selection mechanisms, creating elaborate scoring systems, and so on. The more complicated a system becomes, the harder it is to achieve stable results. By "we," I mean myself and the AI ​​that supports me.
